sections.title: About IWCMPQC
paragraphs: The International Workshop and Conference on Mathematical Models for Post-Quantum Cryptography and its Applications (IWCMPQC 2027) brings together cryptographers, mathematicians, cybersecurity engineers, computer scientists, and industrial R&D leaders.

As the digital landscape prepares for the quantum era, the primary objective of IWCMPQC 2027 is to explore how advanced mathematical domains, including Linear Algebra, Abstract Algebra, Fuzzy Logic, Functional Analysis, Probability Theory, and Numerical Methods, play a role in solving complex security challenges that the post-quantum era faces. The conference emphasizes next-generation cryptographic primitives and their practical deployment across Industrial Control Systems (ICS/SCADA), IoT, Smart Grids, Cloud/Edge networks, and automated manufacturing.

sections.title: About the GRI
paragraphs: The GRI was founded by two dedicated disciples and contemporaries of Mahatma Gandhi, Dr. G. Ramachandran and Dr. T. S. Soundaram Ramachandran. Its foundation is Mahatma Gandhi's revolutionary philosophy of Nai Talim, which effectively bridges the cognitive and practical dimensions and focuses on the holistic development of learners, with an emphasis on skill development through value-based education rooted in indigenous cultures and traditions.

Since its establishment in 1956, GRI has been unstintingly contributing to higher education and has successfully pioneered rural higher education. The curricular model developed at GRI, organically integrating teaching, research, and extension, has earned the Institute the status of Deemed University in 1976 by UGC, five-star status by NAAC in 2002, 'A' Grade during the re-accreditation in 2010 by NAAC, and 'A' Grade in its third cycle of reaccreditation in the year 2016.

sections.title: About CMMQC
paragraphs: CMMQC is a specialized research centre at The Gandhigram Rural Institute (Deemed to be University), Dindigul, Tamil Nadu, India, functioning in association with the Department of Mathematics.

The centre focuses on interdisciplinary research in mathematical modelling, quantum computing, quantum dynamics, complex systems, and algorithmic development for emerging quantum technologies. It also promotes the application of mathematical and computational techniques to address challenging problems in science, technology, and data-driven modelling. The centre also actively contributes to academic and skill development by organizing national and international workshops, training programmes, seminars, and invited lectures. Such programmes provide researchers and students with opportunities to gain knowledge and practical exposure to recent developments in quantum computing, post-quantum cryptography, mathematical modelling, and related computational technologies.

Overall, CMMQC provides an interdisciplinary platform that brings together mathematics, computation, quantum technologies, cryptography, and artificial intelligence, fostering research, innovation, and collaboration in emerging areas of mathematical and computational science.

sections.title: About CUSAT
paragraphs: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) was initially constituted as the University of Cochin through an Act of Kerala Government on 10th July 1971. In February 1986, CUSAT redefined its objectives as "promoting Graduate and Post-Graduate studies and Advanced Research in Applied Sciences, Technology, Industry, Commerce, Management and Social Sciences."

CUSAT is now a world-ranking university with the specific purpose of developing higher education, emphasizing post-graduate studies and research in applied science, technology, industry, humanities, and commerce. CUSAT has consecutively been figured in the Times Higher Education World Ranking since 2017. The Times ranks around 1500 best universities worldwide annually with around 60 universities from India out of 967. CUSAT has also found a place in the QS World University Ranking and the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) of the Government of India.

sections.title: About Department of Mathematics, CUSAT
paragraphs: The combined Department of Mathematics and Statistics came into existence in November 1976, with the major objective of developing it into a Centre of Excellence in this region in mathematical sciences and applications and to provide facilities for training, study and research in these areas. This Department was bifurcated to form an independent Department of Mathematics on 1st January, 1996.

The Department conducts an M.Sc. Degree programme and Ph.D. programmes. Our students find admission to Ph.D. programmes offered in various National Institutes such as IITs, IMSc, ISI, TIFR etc. Apart from giving instruction in post-graduate courses, the Department has from the very beginning taken the leadership in promoting research in mathematics and its applications, especially in this part of the country. This was realized in a two-fold way: one, by guiding young researchers to do their doctoral work, and two, by conducting extension programmes which will improve the instruction at the school and college levels and encourage youngsters to take up research.
